## A-01

**"Check device's route" button opens google.com** (severity 3; frequency high, impact high, persistence high)

The only call to action on the Registration overview page that promises to tell applicants their evaluation route and licence needs links to https://www.google.com. A user who trusts it leaves HSA's site at the moment of the key decision.

Evidence:

- [S03](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/overview/) HSA - Registration overview of medical devices (evaluation routes): link "Check device's route" points to `https://www.google.com`
- [S03](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/overview/) HSA - Registration overview of medical devices (evaluation routes): "Answer a few questions to find out the requirements for your device's registration route and whether you need to apply for a license."

Recommendation: Point the button at the working requirements checker, or remove it until one exists. Add the page to an automated link check (DSS PR-5).

## A-02

**Every link to the "registration and licensing requirements" checker returns 404** (severity 3; frequency high, impact high, persistence high)

The tools page, and result screens in all three self-help tools (51 of 52 risk-class results, 12 of 18 grouping results, 1 of 3 'is it a medical device' results), link to the requirements checker. Both targets return HTTP 404. A link audit of 552 links on 24 HSA web pages found 6 failures, and every one points to this checker. The 404 page offers generic help only.

Evidence:

- [S04](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/tools-and-resources/tools/) HSA - Medical device registration and licensing tools: link "Registration and licensing requirements" points to `https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration/requirements`
- [S04](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/tools-and-resources/tools/) HSA - Medical device registration and licensing tools: "Find out the requirements for your device's registration route and whether you need to apply for a licence."
- [S18](https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/hsa/mdc/is-medical-device) HSA Self Help Tools - Is it a medical device: link "check the registration and licensing requirements" points to `https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/hsa/mdc/medical-devices`
- [S19](https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/hsa/mdc/risk-classification) HSA Self Help Tools - Medical device risk classification tool: link "registration and licensing requirements" points to `https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/hsa/mdc/medical-devices`
- [S20](https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/hsa/mdc/mdc-grouping) HSA Self Help Tools - Medical device grouping tool: link "check your registration and licensing requirements" points to `https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/hsa/mdc/medical-devices`
- [S19](https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/hsa/mdc/risk-classification) HSA Self Help Tools - Medical device risk classification tool: resultsLinkingToRequirementsTool = 51 of 52 results (`evidence/selfhelp-trees.json`)

Recommendation: Restore the checker or redirect both old URLs to the nearest working guidance (Registration overview). Replace the generic 404 with a page that names the most likely destinations. Run a scheduled link check across hsa.gov.sg and selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg.

## A-03

**Route eligibility conditions are stated differently on different pages** (severity 3; frequency medium, impact high, persistence high)

The Registration overview lists 'No prior rejection/withdrawal' as a condition for IBR Condition 2, ECR-1, ECR-2 and EDR. The route guides for IBR (Condition 2), ECR and EDR omit it. Rules on how EU and TGA approvals count (one approval for Class B; not counted if granted via the MRA for Class C/D) appear only in the guides. An applicant who relies on one page can pick a route HSA later rejects, and HSA states fees are then forfeited or not refunded.

Evidence:

- [S03](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/overview/) HSA - Registration overview of medical devices (evaluation routes): "No prior rejection/withdrawal by us or any overseas reference regulatory agencies"
- [S03](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/overview/) HSA - Registration overview of medical devices (evaluation routes): "ECR-2/EDR: Approval from at least two of our overseas reference regulatory agencies No prior rejection/withdrawal by us or any overseas reference regulatory agencies"
- [S06](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/guides/class-b-immediate-registration/) HSA - Register Class B medical device via immediate route: "Condition 2 Approved by at least two of our independent reference regulatory agencies ."
- [S06](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/guides/class-b-immediate-registration/) HSA - Register Class B medical device via immediate route: "Note: If your Class B medical device is approved by both EU and TGA, it will only be considered one approval."
- [S08](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/guides/class-c-expedited-registration/) HSA - Register Class C medical device via expedited route: "Approvals from EU and TGA will qualify as independent reference regulatory agency approvals only if devices have been reviewed and approved by the respective agencies and not registered based on the Mutual Recognition Agreement (MRA)."
- [S10](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/guides/class-d-expedited-registration/) HSA - Register Class D medical device via expedited route: "You are eligible to register your Class D medical device via the expedited evaluation route (EDR) if it is currently approved by at least two of our independent reference regulatory agencies ."

Recommendation: Hold route conditions in one source and render the overview table and every guide from it. State the EU/TGA counting rules in the overview table.

## A-06

**Answering "what do I need?" takes 13 pages and 9 interpretive decisions** (severity 3; frequency high, impact high, persistence high)

With the checker unreachable, persona P1 (Class B importer and wholesaler) needs 19 page loads across 13 pages or files, 2 dead ends and 9 points of rule interpretation or arithmetic to assemble licences, route, fees and documents. Licence logic is spread across prose such as 'Licensed importers require a Wholesaler's licence for wholesale supply.' KLM time is 97 s before reading; the pages visited hold 6,841 words.

Evidence:

- [S14](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/manufacturing-import-and-supply/dealers-licence/apply/) HSA - Apply for a medical device dealer's licence: "Licensed importers require a Wholesaler's licence for wholesale supply."
- [S14](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/manufacturing-import-and-supply/dealers-licence/apply/) HSA - Apply for a medical device dealer's licence: "However, a wholesaler's licence is not required for supply to end-users, such as in a retail store."
- [S14](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/manufacturing-import-and-supply/dealers-licence/apply/) HSA - Apply for a medical device dealer's licence: "Licensed manufacturers do not require a Wholesaler's licence to supply medical devices which are manufactured under their Manufacturer's licence."
- computed: journeyA.asis: 19 page loads, 13 distinct, 2 dead ends, 9 decisions (`data/klm/results.json`)

Recommendation: Provide one pre-application summary that combines activity, class and approvals into licences, route, fees, documents and access steps (prototyped in docs/).

## B-01

**Mandatory dealer reports are a Word form sent by email** (severity 3; frequency high, impact medium, persistence high)

Dealers download a Word form and email it, keeping the email under 2 MB. There is no online submission, no acknowledgement at submission and no status tracking; the HSA reference number arrives only after the initial report. Device users, by contrast, report through a FormSG e-form. Dealers report under 48-hour to 30-day deadlines.

Evidence:

- [S24](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/advertisement-post-market-surveillance-and-safety-monitoring/report-adverse-events/) HSA - Adverse events reporting of medical devices (for companies): "Keep the email size under 2MB."
- [S25](https://go.gov.sg/form-mdc-ade-003-medical-device-adverse-event-reporting-form-1-rev002) HSA - Mandatory Medical Device Adverse Event Reporting Form for Medical Device Dealers (FORM-MDC-ADE-003): "This form, once completed, and any attachment should be submitted via email to hsa_medical_device@hsa.gov.sg."
- [S25](https://go.gov.sg/form-mdc-ade-003-medical-device-adverse-event-reporting-form-1-rev002) HSA - Mandatory Medical Device Adverse Event Reporting Form for Medical Device Dealers (FORM-MDC-ADE-003): "This reference no. would only become available after the initial report has been submitted."
- [S23](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/adverse-events/) HSA - Report adverse events (landing): link "E-form" points to `https://form.gov.sg/#!/5c89abc277ef5300174c1ec7`

Recommendation: Move the dealer report to a structured online form (FormSG or SHARE) with an immediate acknowledgement and reference number, attachments beyond 2 MB, and a link between initial, follow-up and final reports.

## A-04

**Consequence of choosing the wrong immediate route appears only after the eligibility list** (severity 2; frequency medium, impact high, persistence medium)

The Class B immediate guide warns that an eligibility error forfeits the registration only at the end of the eligibility section; the Class C immediate guide says fees are non-refundable. The overview table and fees page, where users compare routes, do not mention it.

Evidence:

- [S06](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/guides/class-b-immediate-registration/) HSA - Register Class B medical device via immediate route: "Error in the eligibility will result in a forfeit of your device registration, and you will be required to re-apply for the registration via other evaluation routes (fees apply)."
- [S28](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/guides/class-c-immediate-registration/) HSA - Register Class C medical device via immediate route: "Fees paid previously are non-refundable."

Recommendation: Show the consequence next to the route in the overview table and on the fees page, before the user commits.

## A-05

**Unclear whether the Class B mobile-app route is a third condition or an alternative** (severity 2; frequency low, impact medium, persistence medium)

On the Class B immediate guide, 'Standalone medical mobile applications' appears as a heading after 'Condition 1' and 'Condition 2' with the single line 'It is solely a standalone medical mobile application.' The overview table presents it as a separate immediate route with its own conditions.

Evidence:

- [S06](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/guides/class-b-immediate-registration/) HSA - Register Class B medical device via immediate route: "Standalone medical mobile applications It is solely a standalone medical mobile application."
- [S03](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/overview/) HSA - Registration overview of medical devices (evaluation routes): "Immediate routes, solely for standalone medical mobile applications: Class B Class C"

Recommendation: Label it 'Route for standalone medical mobile applications' and list its full conditions, as the overview table does.

## A-07

**Payment methods differ between the fees page and the Quick Guide** (severity 2; frequency medium, impact low, persistence medium)

The fees page says fees are payable via GIRO or eNETS. The April 2026 Quick Guide lists GIRO or online payment by card or PayNow through Stripe, and says cheques are not accepted.

Evidence:

- [S11](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/fees/) HSA - Fees and turnaround time for medical devices: "Fees are payable via GIRO ( apply eGIRO ) or eNETS"
- [S17](https://go.gov.sg/quickguideapr2026) HSA - Quick Guide to Medical Device Product Registration and Dealer Licensing, R9 (2026 Apr): "Payment modes available: GIRO or Online Payment (card or PayNow through STRIPE payment portal)"
- [S17](https://go.gov.sg/quickguideapr2026) HSA - Quick Guide to Medical Device Product Registration and Dealer Licensing, R9 (2026 Apr): "Cheques will not be accepted for any transaction."

Recommendation: Update the fees page to match the current payment options and state what is not accepted.

## A-08

**Users must add up fees themselves** (severity 2; frequency high, impact low, persistence high)

The fees table lists a $560 application fee for any Class B, C or D registration on a separate row from each route's evaluation fee, and licence fees in another table. Nothing shows a total for a typical case, so applicants must find and add three or more figures.

Evidence:

- [S11](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/fees/) HSA - Fees and turnaround time for medical devices: "Application fees for any Class B, C or D device registration $560"

Recommendation: Show 'application + evaluation = total' per route, and offer a worked example for a common case.

## A-16

**Dense evaluation-route table** (severity 2; frequency high, impact medium, persistence high)

The overview table packs the EU recognised approvals into one cell of 282 words of Directive and Annex references, alongside nested condition lists. Most applicants need one row.

Evidence:

- [S03](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/overview/) HSA - Registration overview of medical devices (evaluation routes): EU recognised approvals cell = 282 words (`evidence/snapshots/S03.html`)

Recommendation: Lead with a short route summary; move the EU certificate list to an expandable section per class.

## B-02

**"15 minutes" estimate is optimistic and the preparation list is missing** (severity 2; frequency high, impact medium, persistence high)

The form says it 'may take you 15 minutes to fill in' and that 'You will need to prepare some information', without listing it. KLM execution time for an initial report with every fact at hand is 12 min 36 s (77 entries, 1,660 keystrokes), before looking up IMDRF codes, GMDN terms, UDI or three years of frequency data.

Evidence:

- [S25](https://go.gov.sg/form-mdc-ade-003-medical-device-adverse-event-reporting-form-1-rev002) HSA - Mandatory Medical Device Adverse Event Reporting Form for Medical Device Dealers (FORM-MDC-ADE-003): "This form may take you 15 minutes to fill in. You will need to prepare some information to fill in the form."
- computed: journeyB.dealerWordForm: 756.3 s, 1,660 keystrokes (`data/klm/results.json`)

Recommendation: List the information to prepare up front, and base the estimate on observed completion times.

## B-03

**IMDRF coding needs a separate website** (severity 2; frequency high, impact medium, persistence high)

Section VI asks for IMDRF codes for Annexes A to G and points to imdrf.org; the form offers no look-up, so reporters switch between documents and copy codes by hand.

Evidence:

- [S25](https://go.gov.sg/form-mdc-ade-003-medical-device-adverse-event-reporting-form-1-rev002) HSA - Mandatory Medical Device Adverse Event Reporting Form for Medical Device Dealers (FORM-MDC-ADE-003): "VI – International Medical Device Regulators Forum (IMDRF) Adverse Event Terminology (Codes and Terms can be obtained from: https://www.imdrf.org/working-groups/adverse-event-terminology)"

Recommendation: Offer a searchable code picker in an online form, with plain-language terms.

## B-04

**Event categories are named differently on the web page and the form** (severity 2; frequency medium, impact medium, persistence medium)

The web page's timeline uses 'Possible death or serious injury if the adverse event were to recur'. The form's AE Category options are Serious Public Health Threat, Death, Serious Deterioration in State of Health and Others; the mapping to 'Others' is explained only in the guidance pages at the end of the form.

Evidence:

- [S24](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/advertisement-post-market-surveillance-and-safety-monitoring/report-adverse-events/) HSA - Adverse events reporting of medical devices (for companies): "Possible death or serious injury if the adverse event were to recur"
- [S25](https://go.gov.sg/form-mdc-ade-003-medical-device-adverse-event-reporting-form-1-rev002) HSA - Mandatory Medical Device Adverse Event Reporting Form for Medical Device Dealers (FORM-MDC-ADE-003): "AE Category * Serious Public Health Threat Death Serious Deterioration in State of Health Others"

Recommendation: Use the web page's category names in the form, with the deadline next to each option.

## B-06

**Users' form requires a hospital name, even from home users** (severity 2; frequency medium, impact medium, persistence high)

The FormSG form is titled for 'Healthcare Institutions and Medical Device Users', but 'Healthcare facility name' is a required drop-down of 36 hospitals plus 'Other'. Patients at home and GP clinics must choose 'Other' and type something.

Evidence:

- [S26](https://form.gov.sg/api/v3/forms/5c89abc277ef5300174c1ec7) FormSG - Medical Devices AE Reporting for Healthcare Institutions and Medical Device Users (FORM-MDC-ADE-004), public form definition: "Medical Devices AE Reporting for Healthcare Institutions and Medical Device Users"
- [S26](https://form.gov.sg/api/v3/forms/5c89abc277ef5300174c1ec7) FormSG - Medical Devices AE Reporting for Healthcare Institutions and Medical Device Users (FORM-MDC-ADE-004), public form definition: "Healthcare facility name [dropdown, required]"

Recommendation: Ask 'Where did this happen?' with Home, Clinic and Hospital options first, and show the hospital list only for hospitals.

## B-07

**Consent question lets users tick both Yes and No** (severity 2; frequency high, impact medium, persistence high)

'I agree to HSA sharing my name and contact information with the local supplier' is a required checkbox field with two options, 'Yes' and 'No', and no limit on selections, so both can be ticked.

## A-10

**Same concepts go by different names** (severity 1; frequency medium, impact low, persistence medium)

'Overseas reference regulatory agencies' (Registration overview) and 'independent reference regulatory agencies' (route guides) name the same list. The dealer adverse event form refers to a 'Special Authorisation Route Licence No.' while HSA's pages call these 'Special Access Routes'.

Evidence:

- [S03](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/overview/) HSA - Registration overview of medical devices (evaluation routes): "Approval from at least one of our overseas reference regulatory agencies"

- [S16](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/e-services/share-medical-device/) HSA - SHARE (Medical Device) e-service page: "Special Access Route (SAR)"

Recommendation: Adopt one term per concept across pages and forms.

## A-11

**Self-help progress counter overstates the number of questions** (severity 1; frequency high, impact low, persistence medium)

'Is it a medical device' starts with 'Question 1 of 15'. Its decision tree has 12 questions and 3 result screens; the longest path asks 11 questions and the shortest asks 2.

Evidence:

- [S18](https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/hsa/mdc/is-medical-device) HSA Self Help Tools - Is it a medical device: "Question 1 of 15"
- [S18](https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/hsa/mdc/is-medical-device) HSA Self Help Tools - Is it a medical device: 12 questions, 3 results, longest path 11 (`evidence/selfhelp-trees.json`)

Recommendation: Show 'Question n' without a total, or compute the remaining maximum from the current path.

## A-12

**Self-help tool shows a US-format date** (severity 1; frequency high, impact low, persistence low)

'Is it a medical device' shows 'Last Updated: 10/15/2026' (month/day/year), while hsa.gov.sg pages write dates as 'Last updated on 26 March 2026'. Readers using the day/month convention can misread such dates.

Evidence:

- [S18](https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/hsa/mdc/is-medical-device) HSA Self Help Tools - Is it a medical device: "Last Updated: 10/15/2026"
- [S11](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/fees/) HSA - Fees and turnaround time for medical devices: "Last updated on 26 March 2026"

Recommendation: Use the '15 October 2026' format, and state what the date refers to.

## A-13

**Self-help sitemap lists template localhost URLs** (severity 1; frequency low, impact low, persistence high)

selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/sitemap.xml lists https://localhost:3000/ pages (/, /about, /services, /contact) and none of the tools, so search engines are not told the tools exist.

Evidence:

- [S21](https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/sitemap.xml) HSA Self Help Tools - sitemap.xml: "<loc>https://localhost:3000/</loc>"
- [S21](https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/sitemap.xml) HSA Self Help Tools - sitemap.xml: "<loc>https://localhost:3000/services</loc>"

Recommendation: Generate the sitemap from the real routes.

## A-14

**IVD Cluster page still speaks of past dates in the future tense** (severity 1; frequency low, impact low, persistence medium)

The page says 'With effect from 2 June 2026, HSA will be obsoleting the IVD Cluster grouping' and that the feedback window 'is open until 31 July 2026'. On 15 October 2026 both dates have passed, and the grouping tool says the grouping 'has been removed'.

Evidence:

- [S22](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/grouping/ivd-cluster/) HSA - Grouping medical devices as an IVD Cluster: "With effect from 2 June 2026, HSA will be obsoleting the "IVD Cluster" grouping currently found in GN-12-1."
- [S22](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/grouping/ivd-cluster/) HSA - Grouping medical devices as an IVD Cluster: "The feedback window is open until 31 July 2026 ."
- [S20](https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/hsa/mdc/mdc-grouping) HSA Self Help Tools - Medical device grouping tool: "In accordance with GN-12-1 R3, IVD Cluster grouping has been removed and is no longer applicable."

Recommendation: Rewrite in the past tense, or retire the page and redirect to the grouping guidance.

## A-15

The Class C abridged guide lists 'MSDAP' for MDSAP. The Class D expedited guide introduces the QMS list with 'for example' where other guides say 'below', leaving it unclear whether the list is exhaustive.

Evidence:

- [S09](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/guides/class-c-abridged-registration/) HSA - Register Class C medical device via abridged route: "ISO 13485 MSDAP"
- [S10](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/guides/class-d-expedited-registration/) HSA - Register Class D medical device via expedited route: "Proof of at least one Quality Management System, for example:"
- [S07](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/registration-of-medical-devices/register-your-device/guides/class-b-abridged-registration/) HSA - Register Class B medical device via abridged route: "Proof of at least one Quality Management System below:"

Recommendation: Correct the typo and use the same wording in every guide.

## A-17

**Quick Guide link gives no format or size** (severity 1; frequency medium, impact low, persistence high)

Other HSA downloads are labelled like 'Download form [PDF, 297 KB]'. The Quick Guide is linked as 'Quick Guide' via a go.gov.sg short link that opens a 4-page PDF.

Evidence:

- [S02](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/regulatory-overview/) HSA - Regulatory overview (medical devices): link "Quick Guide" points to `https://go.gov.sg/quickguideapr2026`
- [S23](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/adverse-events/) HSA - Report adverse events (landing): "Download form [PDF, 297 KB]"

Recommendation: Label it '[PDF, 4 pages]' and provide the key steps as HTML.

## A-18

**Each page shows two different 'last updated' dates** (severity 1; frequency high, impact low, persistence high)

The fees page header says 'Last updated on 26 March 2026' while the site footer on the same page says 'last updated on 15 October 2026'. Every HSA page reviewed carries the same footer date, which appears to be the site build date, next to an older page date. Readers checking whether fees or rules are current cannot tell which date to trust.

Evidence:

- [S11](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/fees/) HSA - Fees and turnaround time for medical devices: "Last updated on 26 March 2026"
- [S11](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/fees/) HSA - Fees and turnaround time for medical devices: "last updated on 15 October 2026"
- [S04](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/tools-and-resources/tools/) HSA - Medical device registration and licensing tools: "Last updated on 25 May 2026"
- [S04](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/tools-and-resources/tools/) HSA - Medical device registration and licensing tools: "last updated on 15 October 2026"

Recommendation: Keep one date per page, the date the content last changed, and label it 'Content last changed'.

- [S25](https://go.gov.sg/form-mdc-ade-003-medical-device-adverse-event-reporting-form-1-rev002) HSA - Mandatory Medical Device Adverse Event Reporting Form for Medical Device Dealers (FORM-MDC-ADE-003): "Direct Marking Device Identifier (DM-DI)"
- [S25](https://go.gov.sg/form-mdc-ade-003-medical-device-adverse-event-reporting-form-1-rev002) HSA - Mandatory Medical Device Adverse Event Reporting Form for Medical Device Dealers (FORM-MDC-ADE-003): "Direct Marketing Device Identifier (DM-DI)"

On 'Report adverse events', the Medical Devices row of the online submission table offers only the e-form for healthcare institutions and users. The mandatory dealer route is in a separate section further down ('For medical device companies').

## P-01

**Strength: HSA already offers four self-help tools and an AI-assisted classifier** (severity 0)

The tools page lists 'Is it a medical device', a risk classification tool, a grouping tool and the requirements checker; the risk classification page also offers an AI-enabled classification tool in beta. The building blocks for self-service exist; the gap is the last link (A-01, A-02).

Evidence:

- [S04](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/tools-and-resources/tools/) HSA - Medical device registration and licensing tools: "Medical device grouping tool"
- [S19](https://selfhelp.hsa.gov.sg/hsa/mdc/risk-classification) HSA Self Help Tools - Medical device risk classification tool: "New tool available: Try our AI-enabled risk classification tool (beta)"

Recommendation: Keep the tools; reconnect the checker.

## P-02

**Strength: one current Quick Guide covers licensing and registration** (severity 0)

The April 2026 Quick Guide (R9) puts the whole registration and licensing flow on four pages and says both applications can be made at the same time.

Evidence:

- [S17](https://go.gov.sg/quickguideapr2026) HSA - Quick Guide to Medical Device Product Registration and Dealer Licensing, R9 (2026 Apr): "Application for Product Registration and Dealer's Licence can be made simultaneously"

Recommendation: Reuse its structure as HTML (A-17).

## P-03

**Strength: users' e-form keeps typing low** (severity 0)

The FormSG e-form lets users submit a photo of the device label instead of typing device details, and shows only the fields that apply.

Evidence:

- [S26](https://form.gov.sg/api/v3/forms/5c89abc277ef5300174c1ec7) FormSG - Medical Devices AE Reporting for Healthcare Institutions and Medical Device Users (FORM-MDC-ADE-004), public form definition: "Are you submitting the device information as a photo? [yes_no, required]"

Recommendation: Apply the same pattern to the dealer form (B-01).

## P-04

**Strength: clear reporting deadlines** (severity 0)

The companies' adverse event page sets out what to report and when (48 hours, 10 or 30 calendar days) in one table, and says when the clock starts.

Evidence:

- [S24](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/medical-devices/advertisement-post-market-surveillance-and-safety-monitoring/report-adverse-events/) HSA - Adverse events reporting of medical devices (for companies): "The clock for reporting starts as soon as any personnel in your company"

Recommendation: Show the same table inside the dealer form (B-04).
